name: gamepad-2048
title: 2048 - Gamepad
summary: A beautiful 2048 game, tuned for game controllers
description:
gamepad-2048 is a fun, full-featured take on the classic 2048 sliding-tile puzzle, written in Rust and GTK4. It borrows its colour palette and visual language from gamepad-shell, making it a natural fit as a bundled example game for that shell, while still being perfectly playable with a keyboard on a regular desktop.

Features:
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 and 6x6 board sizes, each with its own win target
- Full game-controller support (D-pad and left stick to move, A/Start to confirm, B/Select to go back) alongside keyboard controls
- Persistent high-score tracking per board size
- A slick, animated UI styled after the Ubuntu "Resolute Raccoon" gamepad-shell theme
